root_causes: The Preview 4 screenshot records HTTP 502 during DR24 acquisition, but does not identify the underlying network or source failure.
The bounded HATS-backed DR24 smoke passed on GitHub Windows CI, but this does not establish why the user's machine received HTTP 502.

The frozen application self-test previously failed because pyarrow distribution metadata was missing from the PyInstaller bundle. The Windows dependency lock pins pyarrow==26.0.1; the PyInstaller command previously copied pandas metadata only.
The Windows packaging command now copies both pandas and pyarrow metadata. The exact PR-head frozen application self-test passed.

An interrupted operation is terminal, so retaining PENDING would misstate OID accounting. Both restart and replacement interruption paths now set oid_accounting_status=UNKNOWN; the restart path has regression coverage and passed CI.

A green Scientific Validation contract workflow is not equivalent to a verified scientific release gate.
